item.title: Trump appoints White House aide to panel reviewing ballroom
item.description: President Donald Trump appoints 26-year-old aide Chamberlain Harris to the U.S. Commission of Fine Arts as it reviews White House ballroom plans.

item.title: U.S. single-family housing starts rebound in December
item.description: U.S. single-family homebuilding rebounded in December, but a decline in permits for future construction pointed to underlying weakness amid higher mortgage rates and material costs.

item.title: U.S. factory output posts biggest gain in 11 months
item.description: U.S. factory production rose 0.6% in January, the biggest gain in 11 months, signaling resilience despite tariffs and high interest rates.

item.title: Business spending on equipment ended 2025 on strong note
item.description: U.S. core capital goods orders rose 0.6% in December amid an AI investment boom, signaling strong business spending and solid fourth-quarter growth.

item.title: Mankato bridge work closing lanes
item.description: MnDOT is warning motorists of upcoming lane closures related to the $21.3 million Veteran’s Memorial Bridge project in Mankato and North Mankato.

item.title: DEED offers grants for site cleanups
item.description: The Minnesota Department of Employment and Economic Development is accepting applications for a grant program that helps local communities investigate and clean up redevelopment sites.

item.title: Minnesota Chamber initiative focuses on growth
item.description: The Minnesota Chamber of Commerce has plans for a multiyear initiative dubbed the “Economic Imperative for Growth,” Chamber President Doug Loon told business leaders and legislators Tuesday.

item.title: Twin Cities tenant group plans March 1 rent strike
item.description: Twin Cities Tenants and Inquilinx Unidxs por Justicia plan a March 1 rent strike, urging an eviction moratorium and rental aid funding.

item.title: Lyra at Riverdale Station sold in Coon Rapids
item.description: Sherman Associates sold the 180-unit Lyra at Riverdale Station in Coon Rapids to MLG Capital in a deal arranged by JLL.

item.title: Eagan approves one-year moratorium on large data centers
item.description: Eagan approved a one-year data center moratorium to study noise, water and energy impacts as demand for large facilities grows.
